# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 26 | **Condition:** very fragmentary

---

**26:1** [...] blessed [...] for You have granted [...] knowledge to Your servant [...]

**26:2** [...] to understand Your wonders and to recount [...] the-abundance-of [...]

**26:3** [...] Your mercies. Blessed are You, O Lord, God-of compassion [...]

**26:4** [...] for the-greatness-of Your plan and the-abundance-of Your works [...]

**26:5** [...] are magnificent. Blessed are You, O Lord, who has placed understanding [...]

**26:6** [...] in the-heart-of Your servant, to have-insight into all these things [...]

**26:7** [...] and to restrain-himself from the-works-of wickedness, and to bless [...]

**26:8** [...] Your name. For in Your good-pleasure is [...] all Your works [...]

**26:9** [...] and the-son-of Your handmaid, You [...] in knowledge [...]

**26:10** [...] to stand in Your presence forever [...]

**26:11** [...] and who is he, a mortal, to understand [...]

**26:12** [...] Your great-works? And what is one-born-of woman that he should sit [...]

**26:13** [...] before You? For he is kneaded from dust, and his end [...]

**26:14** [...] is food for worms. He is a thing-of spittle, pinched-off clay [...]

**26:15** [...] and his desire is for the-dust. What shall clay reply [...]

**26:16** [...] and that-which-is-formed-by hand, what counsel can it grasp? [...]

**26:17** [...] and in what shall it be found-righteous? [...]

**26:18** [...] And I, a creature-of dust, what [...] shall I say [...]

**26:19** [...] and what shall I plan for-myself? For [...] in Your wrath [...]

**26:20** [...] Your wonderful [...] mysteries You have revealed to the-ear-of dust [...]

**26:21** [...] and upon the-heart-of [...] You have engraved eternal things [...]

**26:22** [...] and You have opened [...] the-fountain-of understanding [...]

**26:23** [...] for there is no [...] truth except from Your hand [...]

**26:24** [...] and no righteousness apart-from Your counsel [...]

**26:25** [...] and all [...] are before You, and by the-knowledge-of [...]

**26:26** [...] Your truth You have established all [...]

**26:27** [...] and without Your will nothing is done [...]

**26:28** [...] and nothing is known apart-from You [...]

**26:29** [...] Your wonderful mysteries [...] for eternity [...]

**26:30** [...] and ever [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 26 is very fragmentary. The surviving text features a series of blessings (barukh attah) interspersed with the characteristic Hodayot self-abasement (dust, worms, spittle, clay). The "son of Your handmaid" (26:9) echoes Psalm 86:16. "Pinched-off clay" continues the potter imagery. Construct chains hyphenated throughout.*
